summary: Co-Diagnostics filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 16, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing a collaboration with UK-based ReadyGo Diagnostics Ltd. The companies will evaluate combining ReadyGo's GoCollect field sample-preparation system with the Co-Dx PCR platform for blood-based molecular testing at the point of need, initially targeting decentralized Ebola virus detection and outbreak response. No financial terms, equity stake, pricing, or ownership changes were disclosed; no advisors or board recommendations were named. The collaboration extends the platform beyond swab-based testing into bloodborne pathogens such as HIV and hepatitis B and C.
